summary.title: SAFO threat model
summary.description: Threat model of Scrum Around and Find Out as a whole: the board-as-code Action, agent routing and the usage meter, the dispatch guard and hooks, handoff evidence and profiles, writes to GitHub, the install path, GitHub text as untrusted input, guard-file policy, configuration sync and local model routing. The paid Gemini broker is modeled in docs/gemini-broker-threat-model.md and not repeated. Drawn from the repository code and docs; a draft for the maintainer and a cyber-tier review, not an audit.

threats.title: S13: GitHub rate limits and outages stall the board, audits and lookups
threats.description: Asset at risk: availability of the board, the audits and the guard's lookups. Actor class: none; ordinary heavy use. Consequence: work stalls or, in `block` mode, a dispatch is denied. Prerequisites: Actor class: none needed. Rank 16. Tracking: #204.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] The client honors retry-after, the primary reset and secondary-limit or abuse messages with bounded attempts, then raises RateLimitedError (src/safo/graphql.py). [V] Pagination stops at 1000 pages and a response over 32 MiB is refused unread (graphql.py). [V] The guard's lookup has a deadline; an unanswered lookup is denied in `block` mode and a warning in `warn` (docs/no-hidden-work.md). [V] Redirects are refused, so a limit response cannot move the token to another host (graphql.py; tests/test_graphql.py). Verification: tests/test_graphql.py; tests/test_graphql_body_cap.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #204. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S14: GitHub behavior or schema changes and a check's answer
threats.description: Asset at risk: the assurance the checks give. Actor class: GitHub, by changing its behavior. Consequence: a check could report a pass when it should say it cannot tell. Prerequisites: Actor class: a change on GitHub's side. Rank 17. Tracking: #238.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] Fields are read strictly: an absent, null or mistyped field is exit 2 'cannot tell', never exit 0 (docs/adoption.md; tests/test_malformed_nodes.py, test_items_strict.py, test_protection.py). [V] A response that is not JSON, is truncated or is oversized is an error, and a mutation answer that is not understood is an unknown outcome (tests/test_graphql_framing.py). [V] `protection` reads everything twice and exits 2 on any difference (docs/adoption.md). Verification: tests/test_malformed_nodes.py; tests/test_items_strict.py; tests/test_protection.py; tests/test_graphql_framing.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #238. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S04: The approval token and the routing rules rest on model-written text
threats.description: Asset at risk: model-tier spend and routing discipline. Actor class: a prompt-injected or careless agent. Consequence: a dispatch goes ahead that a person did not approve. Prerequisites: Actor class: an agent that writes a brief. Rank 7. Tracking: #81.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] `block` mode makes forgetting visible, and an unrecognized or `inherit` model needs the token (docs/hooks.md rule 1). [V] The log records the model as `unknown`, never the value sent, and never the brief (docs/hooks.md, What is stored). [V] Paid Gemini spend does not depend on the token: it needs a hardware-key signature (docs/gemini.md). Verification: tests/test_guard.py; tests/test_hooks.py; `safo hooks status` shows the mode and the retained counts. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #81. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation. The token is a speed bump and not proof of approval (docs/hooks.md).

threats.title: S08: Guard enforcement: error, timeout and the limits of a text scanner
threats.description: Asset at risk: the guard's rules (waiting, vendor-API use, tracking). Actor class: an agent that writes shell commands. Consequence: a rule does not apply to a call. Prerequisites: Actor class: an agent with shell access. Rank 10. Tracking: #130, #188.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] The decision is computed and written first, on one clock that starts at process start, with a margin before the host timeout (docs/hooks.md, Failing safe; tests/test_guard_emit_first.py). [V] Every degraded allow prints a fixed visible notice and writes an enum-only log record (docs/hooks.md). [V] The Gemini rules keep running when agents.yaml cannot be loaded, and an event too large or incomplete to check is denied (docs/hooks.md). [V] A shell command over 64 KiB, or a check that runs out of time, is denied; constructs the scanner will not guess at have their own verdicts that `block` mode denies (docs/hooks.md). [V] A slow mode file is judged in `block` (docs/hooks.md). [V] The documented limits each have a test that asserts exactly what is allowed (docs/hooks.md, Known limits). Verification: tests/test_guard_emit_first.py, test_guard_entry.py, test_guardlog_timeout.py, test_leadwait.py, test_leadwait_bash.py, test_gemini_bash.py, test_gemini_hook_errors.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #130, #188. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation. The real gates sit in the wrapper, branch protection and the host.

threats.title: S20: Usage meter or outcomes log inputs are not independent evidence
threats.description: Asset at risk: routing and promotion decisions. Actor class: a process of the maintainer's account. Consequence: a worse routing choice, which a person reviews. Prerequisites: Actor class: a process of the maintainer's account. Rank 23. Tracking: none needed (accepted).
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] The meters read through bounded readers and skip a half-written last line (the meters in src/safo/meters use the readers in src/safo/bounded.py; docs/usage.md). The exact caps were not enumerated for this model. [V] Unknown headroom never blocks a route and is printed (docs/usage.md). [V] The outcomes log is validated, kept in a private directory, and promotion counts are a speed bump (docs/limits.md). Verification: tests/test_meters.py; tests/test_outcomes.py; tests/test_usage_mode.py. Residual: Same-user forgery is not defended (S02). The effect is a worse routing choice, which a person reviews. Accepted.

threats.title: S07: Handoff evidence: whether a review report matches the current head and its author
threats.description: Asset at risk: the merge decision. Actor class: an agent commenting through the maintainer's account, or an ordinary later push. Consequence: a pull request looks reviewed when it was not reviewed at its current head. Prerequisites: Actor class: comment rights as the maintainer's account, or any push after a review. Rank 9. Tracking: #106, #160.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] Only OWNER, MEMBER and COLLABORATOR comments count; only reviewing roles count (src/safo/modes/handoff.py). [V] The report is read from GitHub's rendered HTML and only from top-level paragraphs (docs/handoff.md). [V] Freshness needs proof of when the head arrived; without it the answer is unknown, and equal timestamps are unknown (docs/handoff.md). [V] The pull request is read twice and a change between reads is unknown, never fresh (docs/handoff.md). [V] The output says a report names the head; it never says the work was approved (docs/limits.md). Verification: tests/test_handoff_check.py, test_handoff_html.py, test_handoff_timeline.py, test_handoff_snapshot.py, test_handoff_strict.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #106, #160. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S02: Guard files, state and hook wiring share an account with the agents the guard governs
threats.description: Asset at risk: the guard's configuration, state and hook wiring. Actor class: an agent or process running as the maintainer's account. Consequence: tool abuse by that account could change what the guard enforces. The guard is a speed bump and an audit trail, not a boundary (docs/hooks.md). Prerequisites: Actor class: a process of the maintainer's account. Rank 2. Tracking: #61, #130, #231.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] SAFO creates its state and config directories 0700 and degrades visibly when one is not owned by the user or is group or world writable (src/safo/guardlog.py; docs/hooks.md, What is stored). [V] A private agents file must be a regular file owned by the user, with no link on the way and no group or world write above it (src/safo/trust.py). [V] `safo hooks install` keeps a private backup and re-checks the settings file's identity before the replace (docs/hooks.md). [V] Under Actions an agents file or log inside the workspace is refused (docs/hooks.md, Where the local files may live). [V] CODEOWNERS names the maintainer for agents.yaml, the persona paths and the generator (.github/CODEOWNERS). Verification: tests/test_trusted_regular_file.py; tests/test_hooks_dirs.py; tests/test_localfiles_boundary.py; `safo hooks status` shows the installed form and health. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #61, #130, #231. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S03: The maintainer's stored GitHub login is broad and shared with the account's processes
threats.description: Asset at risk: the maintainer's GitHub repositories and organizations. Actor class: a process running as the maintainer's account. Consequence: calls are made with more authority than SAFO needs. Prerequisites: Actor class: a process of the maintainer's account, or theft of the login. Rank 3. Tracking: #82, #232.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] Under GitHub Actions SAFO never runs `gh`; the credentials are the inputs the caller passes (src/safo/credentials.py). [V] SAFO finds `gh` only on absolute PATH entries outside the checkout and strips ambient token variables from the child (credentials.py). [V] The CLI never asks for a broader scope on the user's behalf (docs/usage.md). [V] On the App credential path SAFO mints a one-hour installation token with named permissions; the personal-token path is caller-scoped and is covered by S24 (action.yml). Verification: tests/test_credentials.py; tests/test_gh_token.py; tests/test_cli_credentials.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #82, #232. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S24: The caller-supplied personal access token path of the Action
threats.description: Asset at risk: the repositories and board the token can reach. Actor class: a caller who supplies a token, or whoever obtains it. Consequence: the token's own authority and lifetime apply, and SAFO does not narrow them. Prerequisites: Actor class: a caller using the token input, plus a leak of the token or a broad grant. Rank 6. Tracking: #242.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] A personal access token is refused for an organization-owned board unless `allow-token-for-org` is true (src/safo/credentials.py); a token and an App key together are refused (src/safo/action_preflight.py). [V] The token is masked before use and never printed (src/safo/action_mask.py, src/safo/credentials.py). [V] The named App permissions, the one-hour lifetime and the repository limit describe the App credential path only; the personal-token path is caller-scoped. Verification: tests/test_credentials.py; tests/test_cli_credentials.py; tests/test_preflight.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #242. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

data.name: Action and board modes
data.description: validate, bootstrap, audit, sync, reconcile, status, protection. Mints a one-hour App token.

threats.title: S05: Action credentials and the caller's workflow: data leakage of the Action's credentials
threats.description: Asset at risk: the Action's credentials. Actor class: an outside contributor or a dependency of the caller's workflow. Consequence: the credentials are exposed, or a write is steered by untrusted content. Prerequisites: Actor class: an outside contributor or a compromised dependency; the exposure depends on how the caller wires the workflow. Rank 4. Tracking: #236, ChiefGyk3D/git-your-ship-together#251.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] On the plain `pull_request` event, for a fork's pull request, the preflight refuses a literal key, a token input and a secret-store fetch (src/safo/action_preflight.py). SAFO makes no other claim about the trigger or the caller's workflow. [V] Every credential is masked before use, one line at a time, and the masking command prints no value (src/safo/action_mask.py). [V] On the App credential path SAFO mints a one-hour installation token with named permissions (action.yml); the personal-token path is caller-scoped and is covered by S24. [V] SAFO installs into a fresh hash-pinned venv, runs isolated Python and checks the venv before and after (action.yml, src/safo/venv_check.py). [V] The local modes are refused before anything is minted (action_preflight.py). [V] Inputs reach the shell only through environment variables, and every action in this repository is pinned by commit (action.yml, .github/workflows). Verification: tests/test_action.py (the fork case), tests/test_preflight.py, tests/test_mask.py, tests/test_venv_check.py, tests/test_action_isolation.py, tests/test_workflows.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #236, ChiefGyk3D/git-your-ship-together#251. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S12: Board writes: where the board file and the events come from
threats.description: Asset at risk: the Project board and its cards. Actor class: an outside contributor or a misconfigured caller. Consequence: a write the maintainer did not intend. Prerequisites: Actor class: a contributor whose change is merged, or a caller that is wired loosely. Rank 5. Tracking: #236.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] The loader refuses duplicate keys, anchors, aliases, merge keys, files over 1 MiB and nesting over 64, and caps every list (docs/board-yaml.md). [V] The board file and the status file must resolve to a path inside the workspace (src/safo/action_preflight.py). [V] `sync` treats the event payload as a pointer, reads the live state and writes nothing when they contradict (docs/board-yaml.md). [V] `reconcile` and `sync` write only what a rule can decide and print the rest as `HUMAN` lines; `bootstrap` never edits an existing field's options (docs/no-hidden-work.md, docs/adoption.md). [V] A dry run sends no mutation. On the App path the minted token has read-only Projects permission; a caller-supplied personal token retains its existing authority (src/safo/graphql.py, action.yml). [V] `safo protection` checks that board.yaml and CODEOWNERS have an owner (docs/adoption.md). [V] Adoption asks for the App to be installed on selected repositories only (docs/adoption.md). Verification: tests/test_schema.py, test_duplicate_keys.py, test_schema_caps.py, test_sync.py, test_reconcile.py, test_bootstrap.py, test_codeowners_check.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #236. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S15: Persona, template, agents.yaml or promotion evidence is changed to steer agents
threats.description: A pull request, or a write to the local override, changes the text that is rendered into the instruction files agents obey, or adds plausible outcome records so a profile is promoted. Prerequisites: A merged pull request with the owner's review, or write access to the local files (S02). Rank 18. Tracking: none needed (accepted residual in docs/limits.md).
threats.mitigation: Controls: [V] CODEOWNERS covers agents.yaml, the generated harness files, personas, templates, lessons and the generator; `safo profiles verify` fails when one of those has no owner (.github/CODEOWNERS; docs/profiles.md). [V] Profile text runs through text rules, a phrase tripwire and a private-path check, and the generated diff is read by a person (docs/limits.md). [V] Render digests show a stale or edited generated file; they are not a signature (docs/limits.md). [V] The profile status stays declared in agents.yaml; promotion counts are a speed bump and the maintainer reads the evidence (docs/limits.md). Verification: tests/test_profiles_verify.py; tests/test_profile_text_rules.py; tests/test_manifest_digest.py; `make generated` fails on drift. Residual: A plausible harmful instruction that passes the tripwire and the review is a human judgement (docs/limits.md). Reopen when a profile line is found to have steered an agent wrongly.

threats.title: S17: A write is repeated or its outcome is guessed after an ambiguous failure
threats.description: A connection drops after a mutation was sent, and the client resends it or reports success, which duplicates a card or hides a failed write. Prerequisites: A network fault or a rate-limit response at the wrong moment. Rank 20. Tracking: none needed (mitigated).
threats.mitigation: Controls: [V] Once a mutation has gone out it is never replayed; an ambiguous result raises UnknownOutcomeError and says to re-read state (src/safo/graphql.py, src/safo/mutation.py). [V] A reply with no written object id is an unknown outcome (mutation.py). Verification: tests/test_graphql.py::test_a_mutation_that_commits_then_drops_connection_raises_unknown_outcome and the null-payload cases. Residual: The caller must re-read before retrying; `status --post` notes that an unknown outcome cannot be verified automatically (docs/board-yaml.md).

threats.title: S18: Process rules are satisfied by form and not substance (issue line, threat-model line, linked issue)
threats.description: Asset at risk: the meaning of the process checks. Actor class: an author of a brief, issue or pull request. Consequence: a presence check passes without the thing it stands for. Prerequisites: Actor class: authorship of a brief, issue or pull request. Rank 21. Tracking: none needed (accepted).
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] A brief's issue must be in the listed tracking repositories and be open; an unrelated open issue does not satisfy the rule (docs/no-hidden-work.md). [V] `audit` states it does not open the model file or judge the reason; a person reads them (docs/threat-model.md). [V] The branch gate checks that the default branch requires `CI green`, pinned to the CI app (docs/no-hidden-work.md). Verification: tests/test_tracking.py; tests/test_no_hidden_work.py; tests/test_threatmodel.py; tests/test_branch_gate.py. Residual: These checks make absence visible; they cannot judge truth. Accepted.

threats.title: S19: The protection read-back certifies a state that did not hold at one instant
threats.description: Asset at risk: the assurance the protection read-back gives. Actor class: someone with administrator rights on the repository. Consequence: the read-back reports a state that did not hold at one instant. Prerequisites: Actor class: administrator rights on the repository. Rank 22. Tracking: none needed (accepted).
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] The read is repeated in a different order and any difference is exit 2; the exit-0 output says it is not an instant (docs/adoption.md). [V] An unpinned required check prints a NOTE, and `--require-app-id` makes the pin a condition (docs/adoption.md). [V] The baseline script prints commands in plan mode and an agent never applies it (README.md, scripts/apply-baseline.sh). Verification: tests/test_protection.py; tests/test_apply_baseline.py; tests/test_branch_gate_source.py. Residual: Anyone who can change the protection can defeat the check (docs/adoption.md). Accepted.

threats.title: S21: This threat model goes stale because SAFO's own CI does not run the Threat Dragon check
threats.description: A prompt, agent config or guard change merges with no change to the model, because the shared check is not wired into this repository's CI. Prerequisites: None. Ordinary drift. Rank 24. Tracking: #240.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] The GYST `threat-model.yml` workflow exists and checks the file's shape and that it moves with the AI surface (read for this model); this repository does not call it yet (.github/workflows/ci.yml). [V] tests/test_safo_threat_model.py in this repository checks that the model file and this page agree on the risk ids and carry the required fields. Verification: tests/test_safo_threat_model.py; the GYST check run locally against the file (see the pull request). Residual: Until the workflow is called, only the local test and review keep the model current.

threats.title: S16: A convenience call to the local model evicts a production model
threats.description: `safo local run` or a probe loads a different model or context on a GPU shared with production services. Prerequisites: A routing or configuration mistake. Rank 19. Tracking: #191.
threats.mitigation: Controls: [V] Only allow-listed models are asked for, with exactly the `num_ctx` the resident model is loaded with; protected models are never routed to (docs/local-llm.md). [V] The probe is two read-only GETs and never calls generate (docs/usage.md). Verification: tests/test_ollama.py; tests/test_local_run.py; tests/test_routing.py; tests/test_routing_hostile.py. Residual: When the local server cannot be seen, the lead must stop and ask rather than route around it (#191). Reopen on any eviction of a production model.

threats.title: S06: Supply chain: an upstream release that SAFO runs or installs
threats.description: Asset at risk: the Action's credentials and the maintainer's machine. Actor class: a compromised upstream maintainer or release. Consequence: code runs with the credentials or as the guard. Prerequisites: Actor class: compromise of an upstream release process. Rank 8. Tracking: #216, #162, #163, #165, #233.

Tracked in #216, #162, #163, #165, #233. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S11: Config sync: private SAFO material pushed to a remote
threats.description: Asset at risk: asset A7 and the maintainer's local configuration. Actor class: the maintainer, by a slip, or a wider-than-intended sync scope. Consequence: a private file leaves the laptop for a hosted remote. Prerequisites: Actor class: the maintainer; no attacker is needed. Rank 15. [I] The sync tool lives outside this repository and was not read for this model, so what it pushes is not stated here. Verification: Nothing in this repository checks it; the check is tracked in the private config-sync tracker (maintainer-only). Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in the private config-sync tracker (maintainer-only). SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S01: Prompt injection: attacker-written text reaches a model that holds tool access
threats.description: Asset at risk: the maintainer's repositories, accounts and agent quota. Actor class: an outside contributor. Consequence: text an outsider wrote influences what an agent does with the maintainer's authority. Prerequisites: Actor class: any contributor to a repository an agent reads. Rank 1. Tracking: #81, #61, #123, #230.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] Handoff evidence reads only comments by an OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR (src/safo/modes/handoff.py). [V] `safo profiles brief` puts task text between random-id fences and refuses a value that can close its own fence (src/safo/brief.py). It claims structure only. [V] The status headline model sees four counts and no card titles (src/safo/headline.py). [V] `audit` and the threat-model check read single anchored lines, never free text (src/safo/threatmodel.py). [V] Only the maintainer merges; `safo protection` reads back code-owner review and the `CI green` gate (docs/adoption.md). threats.title: S10: Data leakage to a model host: private text sent to a host that should not receive it
threats.description: Asset at risk: private text in briefs and prompts. Actor class: a careless or prompt-injected agent. Consequence: material reaches a third-party service or a host the configuration did not intend. Prerequisites: Actor class: an agent that writes a brief or a prompt file. Rank 12. Tracking: docs/gemini.md, #235.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] Every Gemini step needs `gemini-material: public`; a secret-shaped string or a match for the maintainer's private terms blocks it, in every guard mode (docs/hooks.md, seventh rule). [V] Local endpoint addresses are validated at load and at connect, and a name is resolved once (src/safo/netguard.py). [V] A redirect is an error, so a prompt is never replayed to a host the configuration did not name (src/safo/ollama.py). [V] A URL with credentials is refused; endpoints come from configuration and never from the repository (docs/local-llm.md). Verification: tests/test_netguard.py; tests/test_ollama.py::test_a_redirect_is_never_followed_so_a_prompt_cannot_be_replayed_to_another_host; tests/test_gemini_guard.py; tests/test_local_run.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in docs/gemini.md, #235. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S23: Local model server: confidentiality of prompts and integrity of results on the local path
threats.description: Asset at risk: prompt confidentiality and result integrity on the local model path. Actor class: a compromised or LAN-adjacent model server. Consequence: prompts are observed or the output is chosen by someone other than the maintainer. Prerequisites: Actor class: a foothold on the home network or the model server. Rank 13. Tracking: #241.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] Address validation and DNS pinning prevent request forgery and rebinding (src/safo/netguard.py). Endpoint authentication is not among the guarantees. [V] A redirect is an error, so a prompt is never replayed to a host the configuration did not name (src/safo/ollama.py). [V] A URL with credentials is refused; the probe is read-only GETs (docs/local-llm.md, docs/usage.md). Verification: tests/test_netguard.py; tests/test_ollama.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #241. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.

threats.title: S25: Local model answer integrity: a local answer applied without review
threats.description: Asset at risk: decisions and documents that use a local answer. Actor class: a model error or a compromised model server. Consequence: a wrong or chosen answer is applied or published. Prerequisites: Actor class: an ordinary model error, or the actor of S23. Rank 14. Tracking: #243.
threats.mitigation: Partial. Controls: [V] Code groups and counts and the model writes prose over a correct structure; a status headline is used only if it is one plain line whose numbers are the computed counts (docs/local-llm.md, src/safo/headline.py). [V] Only field values a reviewer checked are applied from a triage draft (docs/routing.md, issue-triage shape). [V] Review of a local answer before it is applied is a required operating procedure (docs/local-llm.md). Verification: tests/test_status_headline.py; tests/test_local_run.py. Residual: Open. Owner: the maintainer. Tracked in #243. SAFO guarantees only the statements listed under Mitigation.
